title: Transfeminist AI Governance
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. The analysis focuses on power, participation, injustice, and equity in AI governance, with a specific emphasis on transfeminist ethics and harms to marginalized communities such as trans people, Indigenous peoples, and racialized persons.
